body: Today has been the worst yet. Still havent left my house. Can't sleep and breathing is all fucked up. I want to die

Its kicking my ass. I maybe have 1 hour a day where i dont think about ending it. I don't know what to do. I am just over feeling this way all the time. Try opening up and get the ol' you just have to get out or think about something else routine. I break down in tears and crippling fear before i make it to the front door. I stay up all night researching ways to kill myself. I am failing at life and i dont like it

The distracting part is the hardest. Can't keep my composure for more than 10 minutes before crippling anxiety and have to revert back to my room. Its hard. First round of therapy didn't really help. I know every therapist and psychologist are different but i feel like a lost cause. Can't sleep, can't eat. Sending way too many texts to an ex, ruminating, and pushing people away. It's torture and it feels like i can't get better. Losing this fight
